name: RadioButton
label: Radio button
description: Radio button and radio group with vertical and horizontal layouts, animated dot indicator.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error message rendered under the label text

props.name: error
props.description:
Error state — recolours the helper text. Deliberately no `aria-invalid`:
ARIA does not allow it on `role="radio"`; group-level errors carry it on
the radiogroup via RadioGroup's `error`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether this radio is selected

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the radio is disabled

props.name: value
props.description: Value for this radio option, passed to the callbacks and submitted under `name`. A form reads "on", the native radio's, when it is omitted.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with this radio's value when selected

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: onChange
props.description: Legacy change handler, kept for backwards compatibility.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Legacy accessible-name prop.

props.name: name
props.description:
Form field name. When set, the radio submits its `value` with an
enclosing form through a hidden input while checked, nothing otherwise
or while disabled, as a native radio does. Grouping stays React state
(`RadioGroup` passes its own `name` to every option, so exactly one
entry submits).

props.name: label
props.description: Group label

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error message rendered below the group

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — recolours the helper text and marks the group invalid

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the group required and renders the required marker on its label

props.name: value
props.description:
Currently selected value, controlled. Leave undefined to let the group
keep its own selection, seeded from `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Selected value on first render when uncontrolled (`value` undefined).

props.name: name
props.description:
Form field name. When set, the checked option's `value` submits with an
enclosing form through one hidden input, as a native radio set does; a
disabled option submits nothing.
Grouping itself stays React state (`value`/`onValueChange`).

props.name: options
props.type: { label: string; value: string; disabled?: boolean | undefined; }[]
props.description: Radio options

props.name: direction
props.description: Layout direction

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected value

props.description: Additional CSS classes
